levels.title: Before the bus
levels.transitionText: Another morning of standing, waiting for the bus.
levels.instruction: Draw four single-loop combinations. Matching pairs count.
levels.designNote: Two Brimstones make the first available pair; no hazards or seed distraction.

levels.title: The curbside patch
levels.transitionText: I like to watch the insects here, in this patch by the curbside.
levels.instruction: Make four combinations, including two three-species trios.
levels.designNote: Introduce the third silhouette; keep the same curb and route marker.

levels.title: Something in the air
levels.transitionText: Maybe I have an overactive imagination.
levels.instruction: Make five combinations, including two Seed & Wing loops.
levels.designNote: Add airborne seeds and one bottom-edge snail; matching successful arcs make the first ambiguity of magic.

levels.title: Lunch in the atrium
levels.transitionText: Today, for lunch, I bought myself a sandwich.
levels.instruction: Make four combinations, including three figure-eights with one different insect in each pocket.
levels.designNote: Teach the waist crossing using two kinds and large open drawing space.

levels.title: For now
levels.transitionText: I don't know how much longer my job will exist.
levels.instruction: Make four figure-eights, including two with insects and seeds in separate pockets.
levels.designNote: Introduce a two-second seed-moving gust after a visible warning; keep Nursery as the objective.

levels.title: The glass and the leaves
levels.transitionText: This atrium makes me feel calmer.
levels.instruction: Make four figure-eights, including two matching mixed groups.
levels.designNote: Combine the established breeze with matching mixed pockets; glass remains scenery.

levels.title: The way through
levels.transitionText: I always find myself walking home through here.
levels.instruction: Make five combinations, including two Counterpart Pairs containing a lacewing.
levels.designNote: Introduce a paper lacewing that pauses at visible leaf anchors; pair it with another kind in separate pockets.

levels.title: The gaps in the sound
levels.transitionText: I can hear the cicadas. And sometimes I can't.
levels.instruction: Make five combinations, including a Nursery and a matching mixed figure-eight.
levels.designNote: Use lacewing rest intervals to arrange a Nursery and a matching mixed Echo; audio gaps remain decorative.

levels.title: Carrying something home
levels.instruction: Make six combinations, including three single loops and two figure-eights.
levels.designNote: Require switching gestures amid eight fliers; do not introduce a medicine pickup or rescue objective.

levels.title: The window corner
levels.transitionText: I wake up often, and there's always rustling in the corner.
levels.instruction: Trace through firefly, lacewing, then another firefly. Release to complete the sequence.
levels.designNote: Introduce fireflies and Trace mode with a sparse cast. Bodies remain visible between glows.

levels.title: Figures
levels.transitionText: I trace figures, while the world moves around me.
levels.instruction: Make six combinations: include a pair, Seed & Wing, a matching mixed figure, and two traces.
levels.designNote: Introduce an explicit Enclose/Trace selector; reuse the sequence learned in level 10.

levels.title: Tomorrow keeps happening
levels.transitionText: And the world does move. Because tomorrow keeps happening.
levels.instruction: Make seven combinations, including two single loops, two figure-eights, two traces, a Nursery, and a matching mixed figure.
levels.designNote: Synthesize enclosure, partition, and ordered contact; no new rule or forced perfect run.
